title: Advanced Paste: Paste with AI can't find Foundry Local models
author: jacktose
summary: Foundry Local 0.10.3 is healthy with loaded models, but PowerToys 0.101.2362 Advanced Paste shows an empty Foundry Local model list; a second reporter has now confirmed the same behavior.

status.label: Provider compatibility design remains queued
status.detail: The issue supplies enough CLI/service evidence, and the newer confirmation strengthens the Advanced Paste discovery failure without adding a separate root cause.

next_action.label: Investigate SDK discovery compatibility
next_action.reason: Reproduce the 0.10.3 model-list call, surface discovery failures, and define compatible model identity mapping before approval.

judgment.rationale: This remains a credible Advanced Paste / Foundry Local integration defect. The reporter demonstrated that Foundry Local itself is ready with loaded models, PowerToys still renders an empty model list, and current source can convert provider discovery failures into an empty-list UI.
evidence: Foundry Local 0.10.3 reports service Ready and loaded phi-4-mini.
The model works in Foundry CLI, and installing/loading another model produced the same PowerToys result.
Refresh, Foundry server restart, and PowerToys restart did not resolve the empty model list.
A second user commented that they can confirm the same experience.
FoundryClient.ListCachedModels catches exceptions, logs the error, and returns an empty list; Advanced Paste then displays a no-local-model state.
Closed issue 45340 is related Foundry integration history but covered request-time 400 errors rather than current discovery on Foundry Local 0.10.3.
judgment.recommended_action: Queue a compatibility and error-surfacing design; keep approval gated until exact SDK behavior and tests are established.

issue_context.summary: Advanced Paste cannot enumerate models from a functioning current Foundry Local installation.
known_information: Foundry Local 0.10.3 has phi-4-mini loaded and the service is reachable on localhost.
Foundry CLI chat works with phi-4-mini.
PowerToys is 0.101.2362 on Windows 11 Enterprise 25H2 and is running as admin.
The reporter tried refresh, Foundry server restart, PowerToys restart, and another loaded model without success.
A second reporter confirmed the same experience after the initial triage.
inferences: The Foundry SDK call may throw or return data incompatible with the installed service, and PowerToys may be presenting that failure as an empty catalog.
Because another user confirmed the symptom, this is less likely to be a single-machine setup issue, but exact SDK response data is still needed during design.
issue_context.analysis: The behavior is isolated to provider discovery. Another generic ZIP request would not change the next step; the useful work is to reproduce against Foundry Local 0.10.3, distinguish failures from a genuine empty catalog, and surface the failure mode in Settings.
initial_investigation: Inspected FoundryClient.ListCachedModels, which calls FoundryLocalManager.ListCachedModelsAsync, maps cached models through the catalog, and returns an empty list after logging any exception.
Inspected AdvancedPastePage Foundry Local loading, where an empty cached model collection renders the no-local-model state.
Searched PowerToys issues and found only this issue for the exact no-models-downloaded Foundry Local symptom; 45340 is a closed related request-time integration issue.
